english.title: Driver of hackney carriage fail to provide details of person suffered by him to act as driver
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a hackney carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY HACKNEY CARRIAGE..), who had been charged with an offence of suffering another person to act as driver of such hackney carriage without the consent of the proprietor, failed, when required by a justice of the peace so to do, to truly make known the name and place of abode of the person so suffered by him to act as driver without consent of the proprietor, and also the number of the badge of such person if licensed
english.legislation: Contrary to section 27 of the London Hackney Carriages Act 1843.
